utterances.text: Hi Grandma! How have you been?
Oh yes, I remember that! It was quite fun, wasn't it? How have you been since then?
I've been good, just busy with school and everything. How about you?
Oh, I see! Developing a habit sounds like a good idea. I'll try to keep that in mind.
That sounds great! What kind of habit are you thinking of starting?
Oh dear, I misunderstood. I thought you meant to use the app for practice. I'll focus on counting the beats instead.
No worries, Grandma! Counting beats is a great way to practice too. Let me know if you need any help with the app later.
Oh, a new chord! That sounds exciting. I'm ready to learn, dear.
I'm so glad you're excited! Let's start with the basics and build up from there. It'll be fun!
Oh, the G7 chord! I can't wait to try it out. Thank you for teaching me, dear.
You're welcome, Grandma! I'm sure you'll get the hang of it quickly. Let's give it a try together.
Oh, just two fingers? That seems manageable. I'll give it a try right now.
Great! Let's see how it sounds. If you need any help, just let me know.
Oh, I see it now. Let me try to place my fingers like that.
You're doing great, Grandma! Keep going, and let me know if you need any more tips.
Ah, I understand now. Let me try playing it slowly.
That's the spirit, Grandma! You're picking it up so quickly.
Oh, just the left hand? Thank you for pointing that out, dear.
You're welcome, Grandma! I'm always here to help you out.
Alright, let's give it a try with the C chord first.
Great choice, Grandma! The C chord is a good starting point.
Thank you for your patience, dear. Let's start with the C chord then.
No problem at all, Grandma! Let's get started with the C chord.
Oh, I see. Let me try with the G7 chord now.
That's a great choice too, Grandma! The G7 chord will sound lovely.
Alright, I'll keep my thumb in place. Let's move to the next line together.
Great! You're doing so well, Grandma. Let's try playing it together now.
Got it, back to the C chord for the last measure. Thank you for guiding me through this.
You're welcome, Grandma! I'm really enjoying this time with you.
Thank you, dear. I'm glad I'm getting the hang of it with your help.
I'm so proud of you, Grandma! You're really picking it up quickly.
Thank you for the lesson today. I'm looking forward to practicing more.
I'm excited to see how much you'll improve next time!
